initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is 24/60 − 27/90 = 0.10. R214-1 supplies consistency and no interference but no condition identifying the causal effect. Thus the requested average causal risk difference is not uniquely determined; passing arithmetic checks does not establish causal identification.
